text:
[NCBK.3.1] Counters, gauges, and histograms libds emits about its own
operation. Map them to your metrics stack (Prometheus, StatsD, OpenTelemetry,
plain counters, nowhere).

The callback type is `ds_metric_cb_t`, its payload `ds_metric_t`, and it is registered by `ds_engine_set_metric_callback` — all declared in `runtime/include/libds.h`.
